description: This monumental work compiles the legal opinions, theological treatises, and responsa of Ibn Taymiyyah (influential Damascene Hanbali scholar of the Mamluk era, d. 728 AH). It comprehensively covers diverse Islamic sciences, including jurisprudence, creed, ethics, and Quranic exegesis.
